title: Spectator don't last long
style: Lounge pop with a jazz-inflected arrangement. A clean electric guitar plays syncopated jazz chords and melodic fills. A fretless bass performs melodic, sliding lines. Drums feature a light, swinging groove with prominent hi-hat and rimshots. A male baritone vocal delivers a smooth, crooning performance, occasionally shifting into a breathy falsetto. The arrangement includes a bright, staccato brass section and a clean electric guitar solo with light chorus. Key of G major, 115 BPM.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar playing syncopated jazz chords, fretless bass, swinging drum beat]

[Verse 1]
[smooth male baritone vocals]
Spectating
I am gaining the power
This pickleball hour
Energies rising
Sitting despising, can't resist
The pickle bliss

[Chorus]
Itchy feet
Hold on to your seat
The force is strong with this one
Pickleballing [brass section stabs]

[Verse 2]
Player on fire (mmm)
No longer liar (mmm) to yourself
Session half done
Tonight's the one
Spectator in position ready to transition
Like a moth to a flame
Can't resist the game

[Bridge]
Spectators sprung
Stood up and sung
[vocalist belts] A-play the next on

[Outro]
[clean electric guitar solo with light chorus]
Pickleball
Pickleball that's all
[scatting] Do-be-do-be-do-be-do-da-da-da
[final drum hit]
